# Company overview

- Name: Shyena Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Tagline: Cybersecurity for connected systems
- Location: Tikathali - 5, Lalitpur, Nepal
- Registration: 403398/83/84
- PAN: 624728049
- Email: whois@shyenasec.com
- Scope: serves organizations in Nepal and international markets

Focus areas: connected hardware (hardware, firmware, and device security
assessments), operational technology (OT, ICS, and SCADA security
assessments), security products (tools that support security workflows and
hands-on practice), and practical learning (cybersecurity learning through the
public FlagForge platform).

# Home page

https://shyenasec.com/

Headline: Shyena Technologies Pvt. Ltd., cybersecurity assessments for
connected systems.

The page introduces six service areas:

1. Hardware VAPT: review of hardware, firmware, and exposed interfaces within
   an agreed assessment scope.
2. OT / ICS assessment: assessment of industrial control environments,
   including PLC, DCS, and SCADA components.
3. IoT security testing: review of device interfaces, firmware, companion
   applications, and connected services as applicable.
4. SCADA network testing: testing of protocol exposure, network
   segmentation, and access controls in a controlled engagement.
5. Red team operations: exercise of agreed attack paths across connected IT
   and OT environments with operating constraints in scope.
6. Compliance and risk advisory: identification of security gaps and a
   practical, prioritized path for risk treatment.

The page also highlights the company's products (FlagForge, SAFE,
SecYourFlow, and SecYourScan) and recent articles, with contact prompts for each service.

# FlagForge

https://shyenasec.com/products/flagforge

FlagForge is a cybersecurity capture-the-flag platform for practicing web
security, cryptography, reverse engineering, and forensics. It is a public
platform, and the current challenges are available at
https://flagforgectf.com.

Challenge areas include web exploitation, cryptography, reverse engineering,
forensics, binary exploitation, and miscellaneous security puzzles. The platform
supports flag submissions, hints, points, a leaderboard, and GRC lessons.

# SAFE

https://shyenasec.com/products/safe

SAFE (Sensitive-data and Attack Filtering Engine) is an endpoint AI detection
and response agent. Prompts to AI services are checked on the device, and
risky ones are stopped before they leave. Activity is observed from request
metadata, so console visibility covers requests while prompt contents stay
local.

How SAFE works, in four steps:

1. Capture: request activity is observed on the endpoint.
2. Inspect: requests are screened against sensitive-data and attack
   categories.
3. Decide: each request receives an allow, warn, or block decision.
4. Stop: risky prompts are stopped before they leave the device.

SAFE's published held-out test document, which uses synthetic data, reports:

- Structured data: 13 of 14 categories met the detection target.
- False alarms: 5.9% of benign prompts interrupted.
- Latency: 28ms median to parse, detect, and decide.
- Governance: 51 controls across six frameworks.
- Vendor key detectors for AWS, GitHub, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack,
  Stripe, JWT, and database URIs each scored 100% precision and recall.

Stated limits from the same document: names score 56% precision (the model
reads code identifiers and non-English words as names), prompt injection
scores 67% precision and 59% recall, and generic secrets and passwords score
68% and 74% recall.

The page compares SAFE deployment modes: a browser extension at the browser,
a gateway at the network, and an endpoint agent on the device, with a set of
business and error-path rules to apply controls.

More information: https://safe-website-flax.vercel.app/
Inquiries: whois@shyenasec.com with the subject "SAFE inquiry".

# SecYourFlow

https://shyenasec.com/products/secyourflow

SecYourFlow is a self-hosted workspace for assets, vulnerability records,
remediation, risk decisions, suppliers, business impact analysis, and NIS2
work. Its product site is https://secyourflow.shyenasec.com. AI assistance is
optional, with redaction and human-review settings.

# SecYourScan

https://shyenasec.com/products/secyourscan

SecYourScan provides public email and domain exposure checks and a breach
directory. Organisation monitoring covers watchlist matches across leaks,
internet-facing systems, brand abuse, threat actors, suppliers, and response.
Monitor only assets owned by or authorised for the organisation.
Product site: https://secyourscan.shyenasec.com.

https://shyenasec.com/blog

  category IoT security. A device security review can include hardware,
